description: Jasper Leijnsenstraat 2-30 and Jan Haringstraat 26-38 (BAG 1934): 6.2 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a grey tiled roof with box dormers: on every storey three casement windows (a 1.05 m window against the party wall that pairs with its mirrored neighbour's, a 1.65 m wall, then a close pair of 1.3 m windows); ground: the same windows and the paired house doors under a flat canopy at the party wall; a dark gutter at 12.0 m

match.note: Leijnsenstraat 2-30 (BAG 1934, 15 pands of 5.7-7 m, 3DBAG eaves 12.8-13.8 m, ridge 16.7-17.7 m) and Haringstraat 26-38 (7 pands, eaves 13.0 m, ridge 16.8): the strip's gutter stands at 12.0 m with the tiled slope rising to about 15 m behind dormers; 3DBAG reads the dormer-level eaves. Leijnsenstraat 2 (eaves 14.9 m) and 4-14 (13.6-13.8 m) are told by the photo

gutter.note: Leijnsenstraat 2-30 strip: a dark gutter at 12.0 m, the grey tile slope above it to about 15 m; box dormers 2.0 m wide at 13.2-14.5 m are not drawn; dormer: one zinc box dormer per pand, 2.0 m wide, sill 0.9 m over the gutter (Leijnsenstraat 2-30 strip: 13.2-14.5 m)

door-left.note: paired house doors at the party wall under one flat canopy at 2.9 m (doors 0-2.3 m), the other two ground windows 0.78-2.65 m; mirrored when the strip reads the door on the right

roof.evidence: Leijnsenstraat 2-30 strip: grey tile slope from the 12.0 m gutter rising to 15 m with box dormers; 3DBAG ridge 16.7 m

rhythm.symmetry: mirrored pands pair their single windows (and doors) across the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: paired house doors under a canopy at the party wall
rhythm.roofline: dark gutter under a tiled slope with box dormers
